scope: Benchmark rollout and judge usage for this implementation campaign, including pilots, invalidated attempts, first pass, and recovery trials. Older user experiments and unmetered development-assistant usage are excluded.
cost_basis: Repository cache-aware model rates; provider-reported judge charges where available, otherwise recorded GPT-5.2 usage at documented local proxy rates. Infrastructure excluded.
limitation: Recorded spending is a lower bound: some earlier cancelled Python/provider and judge requests returned no captured usage. Unknown charges are not represented as zero.
